title: AEON Learn learner state
description: Serialisable learner state, used for persistence when memory is available and for the resumable state block when it is not (protocol/state.md). Only journey is required so that partial and in-flight states validate.

profile.description: Free-form learner profile, typically populated from the discovery dimensions: current_knowledge, learning_goal, desired_depth, daily_time_budget, program_duration, preferred_language, preferred_formats, professional_context, desired_practical_application, assessment_preference.

objective.description: What the learner wants to understand or be able to do afterwards.

started_at.description: When the journey started, as an ISO 8601 date or date-time.

curriculum_version.description: Version of the compiled curriculum this state was built against.

state.description: Current position in the journey state machine (protocol/state.md). An addition to the baseline learner-state block so the state machine is serialisable.

progress.description: Where the learner is within the curriculum.

completed_sessions.description: Identifiers of completed sessions, in completion order.

current_session.description: Identifier of the session currently in progress, or null between sessions.

mastery.description: Mastery estimates keyed by concept or module id. The value shape is runtime-defined, for example a 0 to 1 score or a label.

preferences.description: Stable delivery preferences gathered during discovery.

language.description: Preferred teaching language, as a BCP 47 tag or a natural-language name.

session_duration.description: Target daily session length; integer minutes preferred, a phrase such as "20 minutes" accepted.

formats.description: Preferred output formats, for example podcast, deep dive, presentation, exercises.

adaptation.description: Adaptation parameters derived from learner signals. Adjusting them never violates prerequisite structure.

difficulty.description: Current difficulty setting for upcoming modules.

depth.description: Current depth setting for upcoming modules.

weak_areas.description: Concept or module ids the learner struggles with; candidates for retrieval and reinforcement.

strong_areas.description: Concept or module ids the learner has demonstrably mastered; candidates for compression.
